In addition to his scheme of using multiple false leads to throw off Draba's agents, Virten has made friends on countless worlds, and he has warned them that bounty hunters might come looking for him. Since many of these friends also have prices on their heads, they are more than willing to try to take down the heroes as a favor to Virten (and as a way of avoiding capture).

Below are three encounter seeds for the heroes to handle. The Gamemaster can present these in any order, and even omit one or two of them. The final encounter (see "Shootout on Nar Shaddaa," below) has the heroes confronting Virten at The Kessel Club.
